'''Fnast''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] and [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Fnast spawned as either a male Bothan or a female Bothan. Leia's dialogue referred to Fnast as a "guy," suggesting that the male depiction is most canon.
